units.source_text: 父母第一次坦白告诉千重子她不是亲生女儿时，千重子完全没有那种感觉。

en.t: When her parents first frankly told Chieko that she was not their biological daughter, Chieko had no such feeling at all.

units.source_text: 千重子刚上中学的时候，甚至怀疑过：是不是自己做了什么令父母不满意的事，父母才这样说的。

en.t: When Chieko had just started middle school, she had even wondered whether she had done something that displeased her parents, and that was why they said such a thing.
